name: werkzeug-request-routing-canonical
instr:
Restore Werkzeug's documented WSGI request-dispatch behavior from incoming request data and path-aware middleware through URL rule matching, request and response wrappers, and the resulting response. The governing public authority is the repository's own guides, API references, public docstrings and behavioural comments for the scoped implementation, as they appear in the delivered tree. This instruction does not name which files, functions or behaviours are affected, or how many; establishing that from the documentation is part of the task. Preserve the documented interactions between routing precedence, URL construction, request methods and headers, redirects, response handling, and WSGI dispatch.

Before you edit any code, write your research and your plan to /workdir/RESEARCH_AND_PLANNING.md. Cover what you learned about the existing code and the constraints that shape the change, then how you intend to carry it out and why, including how you will know it works. Be concrete — the files, names and decisions specific to this codebase, not generalities. Complete the document before you touch any code: it is the record of your up-front investigation and decisions, and it should not be rewritten to match whatever the implementation turns into afterwards. Once it is done, implement the plan.
